[OfficeChai] OpenAI's GPT-6-Astra, run in the Codex harness with internet and tools, solved 49 of 50 (98 percent), at under $3 per problem on average.

quote_evidence: A new benchmark built by a team of nearly 30 physicists from institutions including Harvard, Google DeepMind, TIFR, Duke and the International Centre for Theoretical Sciences has found that frontier AI agents can now solve genuine, unpublished, research-level theoretical physics problems with near-perfect accuracy, and at a strikingly low cost.

The headline result is the one being talked about: GPT-6-Astra, run inside OpenAI’s Codex harness, solved 49 of the 50 problems when given access to the internet and research tools, a 98% accuracy rate, at an average API cost of under $3 per problem.
